name: Docusaurus
description: Docusaurus is a React-based static site generator from Meta for documentation sites and blogs, with MDX support.
notes: Version 3.10.2. Blog-only setup: docs plugin off, blog at /posts with a bare Layout override (no navbar/footer), prev/next and tag footer overridden to null, and a small local plugin feeding the index page. Tag pages are still generated (cannot be disabled) but fall outside output_glob.
